# victorops_scheduled_override (Resource)

Manages a scheduled override in VictorOps/Splunk OnCall.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "victorops_scheduled_override" "vacation" {
  username = "jdane"
  timezone = "America/New_York"
  start    = "2024-12-20T09:00:00Z"
  end      = "2024-12-27T09:00:00Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end` (String) The end time of the override in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-01T17:00:00Z').
- `start` (String) The start time of the override in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-01-01T08:00:00Z').
- `timezone` (String) The timezone for the override (e.g., 'America/New_York').
- `username` (String) The username of the user being overridden.

### Optional

- `assignment` (Block List) Assignments for this override. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--assignment))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `public_id` (String) The public ID of the scheduled override.

<a id="nestedblock--assignment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assignment`

Required:

- `policy_slug` (String) The slug of the escalation policy to assign.
- `username` (String) The username of the person taking the override.

Optional:

- `accept_overlap` (Boolean) Accept overlap with existing scheduled overrides.
